While a founding year is not publicly disclosed, the company has developed a portfolio of solid-state power control and signal-conditioning products over several decades.

EDR designs and manufactures a broad line of solid-state relays (SPST, SPDT, DPST) using MOSFET and IGBT outputs, ranging from the low-cost D1L series to the super-high-power D9F and D9G series capable of switching up to 1,000 A RMS at 650 VDC.
